feeds.title: Your Homebased Mom Blog
feeds.description: Leigh Anne is a mother of four amazing, grown children and a mother-in-law to two beautiful daughters-in-law that she is grateful for daily. She and her husband, Jim, live in Portland, Oregon. A food and lifestyle blog sharing hundreds of delicious, family-friendly recipes and entertaining ideas that everyone will love. Follow to get updates.

feeds.title: Urban Bliss Life
feeds.description: Food, wine, travel guides: easy family-friendly recipes, wine pairings & wine reviews, culinary & wine travel guides from food, wine, and travel pro Marlynn Schotland.

feeds.title: Create-Enjoy
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Suzannah, a serious DIYer. Follow along with my DIY fixer upper house renovations, sewing and crafty projects, real food recipes, and de-stressing goals. Adventures in Dressmaking is now Create/Enjoy, a DIY blog for a happier life.

feeds.title: The House of Hood Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to The House of Hood Blog! Hi, I'm Chelsee! I'm Ryan's wife and mom to two beautiful blonde hair brown eyed babes and one handsome golden retriever named Dexter. The House of Hood Blog is a Portland Oregon based lifestyle and motherhood blog.

feeds.title: Made to Mother
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Wynter. Wife to Jonathan and mama to Chloe, Adaya, and Liam. I am a writer, artist, MarCom professional, freelance editor, and an avid gardener, TV lover, and chocolate-covered cherries addict. Come back here each week for new, powerful stories of motherhood from real moms across the mother spectrum.

feeds.title: PNW Mountain Mommy
feeds.description: I'm Autumn Bettinger, a first-time mom and lifetime nature lover. With a new son of my own, I have the opportunity to introduce him to the beautiful natural spaces so close to where we live. It is my hope to inspire not only him but other mothers out there, that nature is certainly nurtured. This blog is a way to document the day-to-day life of motherhood and my approach to it.

feeds.title: Seasons + Salt
feeds.description: I'm Andrea, my husband and I are parents to three kids, two girls, aged 9 and 7, and a little boy who is about to turn 5. S+S is a simple style blog tailored to share sustainable, ethical, and independent designers. I'm here to show you that ethics and style aren't mutually exclusive. Follow to get updates.

feeds.title: Twins & Coffee
feeds.description: My name is Lynneah, and I have boy-girl twins, Kendall and Caeden. I enjoy sharing the raw side of motherhood from lazy day recipes, real-life travel tips, to everyday events life brings as a mom of twins. My goal is to empower and motivate new moms into believing you CAN do it. Follow to get the updates.

feeds.title: Posie Gets Cozy
feeds.description: My name is Alicia Paulson and I love to make things. I live with my husband and daughter in Portland, Oregon, and design sewing, embroidery, knitting, and crochet patterns. Subscribe the blog to know more!
